Info

Interface protocol defining analytical SCARA kinematics calculations and reachability.

class scarajectory.core.service.kinematics.ikinematics_service.IKinematicsService(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural interface protocol for analytical SCARA kinematics calculations.

It defines:

attributes:
bounds - Active robot geometry bounds and limits model.
r_min - Minimum annular workspace reach radius in mm.
r_max - Maximum annular workspace reach radius in mm.
methods:
solve_ik - Solves analytical inverse kinematics for joint angles.
solve_fk - Computes Cartesian coordinates from joint angles.
is_in_workspace - Checks whether coordinates fall within annular and height envelope.
is_joint_reachable - Evaluates if position is reachable within joint and singularity limits.
property bounds: ScaraBounds¶

Returns the active robot geometry and limits model.

Returns:

ScaraBounds instance.

is_in_workspace(x: float, y: float, z: float) → tuple[bool, str][source]¶

Checks whether target coordinates lie within the physical annular workspace and Z limits.

Parameters:

  • x – Target Cartesian X coordinate in mm.

  • y – Target Cartesian Y coordinate in mm.

  • z – Target Cartesian Z coordinate in mm.

Returns:

Tuple of (is_in_bounds, error_or_warning_message).

is_joint_reachable(x: float, y: float) → tuple[bool, list[str]][source]¶

Evaluates whether target position can be achieved within physical joint limits and singularity deadband.

Parameters:

  • x – Target Cartesian X coordinate in mm.

  • y – Target Cartesian Y coordinate in mm.

Returns:

Tuple of (is_reachable, list_of_warning_messages).

property r_max: float¶

Returns the maximum annular workspace reach radius in mm.

Returns:

Maximum reach radius float value.

property r_min: float¶

Returns the minimum annular workspace reach radius in mm.

Returns:

Minimum reach radius float value.

solve_fk(theta1: float, theta2: float) → tuple[float, float][source]¶

Computes Cartesian end-effector position from joint angles via forward kinematics.

Parameters:

  • theta1 – Joint 1 (shoulder) angle in radians.

  • theta2 – Joint 2 (elbow) angle in radians.

Returns:

Tuple of (x, y) Cartesian coordinates in mm.

solve_ik(x: float, y: float, elbow_left: bool = False) → tuple[float, float] | None[source]¶

Solves analytical inverse kinematics for SCARA 2-DOF arm.

Parameters:

  • x – Target Cartesian X coordinate in mm.

  • y – Target Cartesian Y coordinate in mm.

  • elbow_left – True for elbow-left configuration, False for elbow-right.

Returns:

Tuple of (theta1, theta2) in radians, or None if mathematically unreachable.
